verdict.rationale: INPI says it built the free Start INPI app to guide users through each step of their formality with tutorials and videos. Its 'déposer vos actes' page also explains fees, payment methods, signature requirements and how to track a filing in plain French, with click-level instructions. However, the evidence names the tutorials only once and never shows their depth, coverage or ease of use, so full step-by-step guidance for every founder task is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of actual step-by-step explainer content across tasks (creation, modification, cessation), confirmation that guides cover all formalities, independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers can follow them.
